[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.13x): Increased volume accompanying recent moves, suggesting moderate confidence in directional movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): RSI neutral, MACD worsening, weekly ADX at 27.1 indicates a trend but with -DI dominance. Further observation is needed for indicator improvement before considering a buy entry.
